$comment: Consolidation plan: each exposed tool is one noun-and-direction (read or write) whose `method` selects one of the original single-route tools in src/tools/*.ts. Every original tool must appear exactly once (tests/consolidation.test.ts enforces it). A tool with one method is exposed under the original name and shape. `core_groups` are enabled at startup; the rest load on demand through scf_load_tools.

groups.catalog: SCF reference catalog: controls, domains, frameworks, assessment objectives, evidence definitions (no org)
groups.controls: The organization's control scope: scoping, implementation status, maturity, basis, materiality, procedures
groups.evidence: Evidence tracking records, files, validation, tasks, collection health and maturity guidance
groups.assessments: AI evidence assessments: per-file and windowed verdicts, review queues, control composites
groups.risk: Risk register, custom risks, risk matrix and treatment
groups.vendors: Third-party risk: vendors, research, assessments, certifications, compensating controls, action items
groups.systems: Systems inventory and evidence capabilities, capability themes (KSI) scorecards
groups.organization: Organizations, members, settings, audit log, work queues, notifications, current user
groups.teams: Business functions, teams, rosters and team accountability for controls and evidence
groups.collaboration: User assignments and comment threads on controls, evidence and tasks
groups.documents: ISMS document generation, sections, lifecycle transitions and export
groups.engagements: Audit engagements: scope, auditors, queries and responses
groups.assurance: Deficiencies, organization compensating controls, control validations, posture snapshots, capability tests
groups.catalog-reconciliation: Per-organization SCF catalog upgrade reconciliation runs
groups.webhooks: Webhook endpoints, secrets and delivery logs
groups.journey: The guided implementation journey: stages, templates, attestation

scf_catalog_read.title: SCF Catalog
scf_catalog_read.description: Read the SCF reference catalog (no org): controls, one control with its objectives and evidence, domains, frameworks, assessment objectives, evidence definitions. Pick with method.

scf_control_read.title: Scoped Controls (read)
scf_control_read.description: Read the organization's control scope: list scoped controls with filters, one control in full, scoping stats, framework scope summary, or preview a framework scope change. Pick with method.

scf_control_write.title: Scoped Controls (write)
scf_control_write.description: Change the organization's control scope (editor+; some methods admin): update or batch-update controls, scope or unscope a framework, set scope, basis, maturity, materiality or procedure overrides.

scf_evidence_read.title: Evidence (read)
scf_evidence_read.description: Read evidence tracking: list records, one record with its in-scope requiring controls, requiring controls alone, gaps, health, upcoming, frequency health, maturity and upgrade guidance, suggestions.

scf_evidence_write.title: Evidence (write)
scf_evidence_write.description: Create or update evidence tracking records (editor+): create one from a catalog id, upsert one record's tracking fields, or batch-upsert up to 500 in one transaction. Pick with method.

scf_evidence_file_read.title: Evidence Files (read)
scf_evidence_file_read.description: Read an evidence item's files: list them, one file with its download URL, one file's validation result, or the organization's validation summary. Pick with method.

scf_evidence_file_write.title: Evidence Files (write)
scf_evidence_file_write.description: Act on an uploaded evidence file (editor+): approve, reject or request revision; re-run validation; or soft-delete it (destructive). Pick with method.

scf_evidence_task_write.title: Evidence Tasks (write)
scf_evidence_task_write.description: Manage evidence collection tasks (editor+): create one against a tracking record, update its fields, or mark it completed with notes. Pick with method.

scf_assessment_read.title: AI Assessments (read)
scf_assessment_read.description: Read AI evidence assessments: a file's verdict, the file summary, review queues, window assessments (list, one, versions, summary), and control composites. Pick with method.

scf_assessment_write.title: AI Assessments (write)
scf_assessment_write.description: Run and review AI evidence assessments (editor+, async): assess a file or many, assess a window or many, refresh stale windows, confirm or override verdicts, set window acceptance.

scf_risk_read.title: Risks (read)
scf_risk_read.description: Read the risk register: list risks, one risk, the 5x5 matrix, summary, profile, risks for a control, or controls for a risk. Pick with method.

scf_risk_write.title: Risks (write)
scf_risk_write.description: Change the risk register (editor+; accept is admin): create a risk assessment, update one, delete one (destructive), or record or renew a risk acceptance. Pick with method.

scf_custom_risk_read.title: Custom Risks (read)
scf_custom_risk_read.description: Read organization-defined custom risks: list them, or list the controls linked to one. Pick with method.

scf_custom_risk_write.title: Custom Risks (write)
scf_custom_risk_write.description: Manage custom risks (editor+): create, update or delete a risk (destructive); add, update or remove a linked control. Pick with method.

scf_vendor_read.title: Vendors (read)
scf_vendor_read.description: Read third-party risk data: list vendors, one vendor, its research, assessments (list, one, latest, status), certifications, compensating controls, action items. Pick with method.

scf_vendor_write.title: Vendors (write)
scf_vendor_write.description: Manage vendors (editor+): create or update a vendor, trigger AI research, or trigger a DPSIA assessment (async). Pick with method.

scf_vendor_record_write.title: Vendor Records (write)
scf_vendor_record_write.description: Manage a vendor's sub-records (editor+): create, update or delete a certification, a compensating control, or an action item. Deletes are destructive. Pick with method.

scf_system_read.title: Systems (read)
scf_system_read.description: Read the systems inventory: list systems, one system, catalog templates, a system's capabilities and recipes, recipe status, org evidence capabilities, systems for an evidence type.

scf_system_write.title: Systems (write)
scf_system_write.description: Manage the systems inventory (editor+): create or update a system, declare or update an evidence capability, or generate collection recipes (async). Pick with method.

scf_capability_theme_read.title: Capability Themes (read)
scf_capability_theme_read.description: Read capability themes (KSIs): list themes, one theme, the multi-axis scorecard, per-theme evidence posture, or the controls mapped to a theme. Pick with method.

scf_org_read.title: Organization (read)
scf_org_read.description: Read organization data: list organizations, one organization, its settings, members, audit log, change cursor, or the organization work queue. Pick with method.

scf_user_read.title: Current User (read)
scf_user_read.description: Read the caller's own view: the current user (the API key's identity), their work queue, or their notifications. Pick with method.

scf_team_read.title: Teams (read)
scf_team_read.description: Read teams: list teams, one team with its roster, business functions, or team assignments to controls and evidence. Pick with method.

scf_team_write.title: Teams (write)
scf_team_write.description: Manage teams (editor+): create or update a team, add or remove a member, create one or many team assignments, or delete one (destructive). Pick with method.

scf_collaboration_read.title: Collaboration (read)
scf_collaboration_read.description: Read collaboration data: user assignments to controls, evidence and tasks, or comment threads on an entity. Pick with method.

scf_collaboration_write.title: Collaboration (write)
scf_collaboration_write.description: Change collaboration data (editor+): create or delete a user assignment; create, update or delete a comment. Deletes are destructive. Pick with method.

scf_document_read.title: ISMS Documents (read)
scf_document_read.description: Read ISMS documents: list, one document, export, preview, history, a generated section, generation status, settings, available domains, generators. Pick with method.

scf_document_write.title: ISMS Documents (write)
scf_document_write.description: Change ISMS documents (editor+): generate documents (async), transition lifecycle state, update or resolve a section, or update generation settings. Pick with method.

scf_engagement_read.title: Audit Engagements (read)
scf_engagement_read.description: Read audit engagements: list, one engagement, the caller's engagements, scope, presentation, auditors, queries, one query. Pick with method.

scf_engagement_write.title: Audit Engagements (write)
scf_engagement_write.description: Change audit engagements (editor+): create, update or delete one (destructive); add or remove an auditor; raise a query, set its status, or respond to it. Pick with method.

scf_assurance_read.title: Assurance (read)
scf_assurance_read.description: Read assurance records: deficiencies (list, one, summary), organization compensating controls, control validations, posture snapshots, capability tests. Pick with method.

scf_assurance_write.title: Assurance (write)
scf_assurance_write.description: Record assurance (editor+): create or update a deficiency or compensating control, record a control validation, take a posture snapshot, create or update a capability test, add a finding.

scf_catalog_reconciliation_read.title: Catalog Reconciliation (read)
scf_catalog_reconciliation_read.description: Read SCF catalog reconciliation for an organization: status, the catalog changelog, reconciliation runs, or one run. Pick with method.

scf_catalog_reconciliation_write.title: Catalog Reconciliation (write)
scf_catalog_reconciliation_write.description: Drive a catalog reconciliation (admin): preview a run, set per-change actions, apply, cancel, or roll back a run. Pick with method.

scf_webhook_read.title: Webhooks (read)
scf_webhook_read.description: Read webhook endpoints: list them, one endpoint, or its delivery log. Pick with method.

scf_webhook_write.title: Webhooks (write)
scf_webhook_write.description: Manage webhook endpoints (admin): create one, rotate its signing secret, or delete it (destructive). Pick with method.

scf_journey_read.title: Journey (read)
scf_journey_read.description: Read the guided implementation journey: the staged path with preconditions evaluated, or the available templates. Pick with method.

scf_journey_write.title: Journey (write)
scf_journey_write.description: Change the journey (editor+): import or replace it from a template or artefact, or attest that a stage is complete. Pick with method.
